platform: Edge Radio 99.3FM Global Digital Music Submission
manual_review_reason: Edge Radio accepts digital submissions through an official protected first-party email route and asks for a short bio, upcoming-gig details, a streaming link and a high-quality downloadable file in 320 kbps MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC or OGG. The actual mailbox is protected in passive rendering and was not decoded. A human must open the official page, confirm the displayed address, select and permission-check the stream and download links, approve the bio and ensure the submission is not falsely labelled as Tasmanian. The optional multi-copy CD route and any paid promotional campaign must remain separate.

SYN directs music submissions to music@syn.org.au and requires a downloadable 320 kbps MP3 or WAV link rather than direct file attachments, plus a press release or artist bio, track or EP/album title, release date and relevant website, social, gig or previous-release links. A human must choose the release and focus track, confirm that the download link is accessible without exposing private credentials, verify file quality and metadata, review the pitch and send the email manually. Rolling review does not guarantee a response.

platform: JOY 94.9 Global and Rainbow Artist Music Submission
manual_review_reason: JOY invites artists who are Australian, independent or part of LGBTIQA+ communities and whose music fits its daytime or specialist programming to send a stream link through an official protected first-party music address. The mailbox was not decoded. A human must confirm the displayed address, verify that MarcsMusic qualifies through the independent-artist criterion, select an uplifting or specialist-fit track, approve the stream permissions and submit manually. Physical CD delivery and direct outreach to a specialist show are optional routes requiring separate human approval. The CAPTCHA and honeypot visible on the page belong to an unrelated newsletter form and must not be used as a submission path.
